That history is now poised to continue, creating imaging solutions that provide our customers with
quantifiable gains and real-world benefits. Carestream has always been here for you. We always will
be. Together, let’s continue to shape the future of imaging.

# Toshiba America | Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions

## About Toshiba AMERICA

### Toshiba specializes in providing comprehensive Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions
### across the Americas.

[ Learn More ][246]

## From Power Generation to Decarbonization: Toshiba Leads the Way

Anchoring the power generation capabilities of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions,
Toshiba America Energy Systems (TAES) focuses on advanced power generation and decarbonization. We
provide technical services for installed energy equipment while pioneering carbon-neutral
technologies—including hydrogen, carbon capture, and next-generation geothermal. From thermal and
nuclear to hydro power, TAES is building a reliable path forward.

 

Discover how we’re shaping the energy landscape for a cleaner planet.

[ Learn More ][247]
[Rolling green hills with wind turbines in the background, symbolizing Toshiba's commitment to
sustainable power generation and clean energy solutions.]
[Wind-powered energy-generated windmills on a green hillside.]
[Technician in hard hat and safety vest working on industrial equipment, representing Toshiba's
on-site services for manufacturing and critical infrastructure.]

## Driving Sustainability: Toshiba's Industrial and Infrastructure Innovations

Spearheading the manufacturing and infrastructure side of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics
Solutions, Toshiba International Corporation (TIC) delivers technologies for a resilient future. We
maximize efficiency with high-performance motors, hybrid vehicle systems, and power electronics like
UPS and solar inverters. From sustainable transportation to water treatment, TIC provides the
innovation and reliability that powers modern industry.

 

Discover how we’re revolutionizing industrial solutions and infrastructure for a better future.

[ Learn More ][248]

## Empowering the Future: Semiconductor & Data Innovations

Defining the technological edge of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions, Toshiba
America Electronic Components (TAEC) leads in semiconductors and data storage. Our energy-efficient
power devices—including Si, SiC, and GaN—and high-capacity hard disk drives support a rapidly
developing AI world. From automotive to industrial applications, we deliver the technology driving
modern innovation.

 

Discover how we’re leading the semiconductor revolution for a smarter, more sustainable future.

[ Learn More ][249]
[Close-up of a Toshiba semiconductor chip overlaid on the internal components of a hard drive,
illustrating Toshiba’s advanced semiconductors and data storage solutions.]

# Toshiba America | Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions

## About Toshiba AMERICA

### Toshiba specializes in providing comprehensive Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions
### across the Americas.

[ Learn More ][246]

## From Power Generation to Decarbonization: Toshiba Leads the Way

Anchoring the power generation capabilities of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions,
Toshiba America Energy Systems (TAES) focuses on advanced power generation and decarbonization. We
provide technical services for installed energy equipment while pioneering carbon-neutral
technologies—including hydrogen, carbon capture, and next-generation geothermal. From thermal and
nuclear to hydro power, TAES is building a reliable path forward.

 

Discover how we’re shaping the energy landscape for a cleaner planet.

[ Learn More ][247]
[Rolling green hills with wind turbines in the background, symbolizing Toshiba's commitment to
sustainable power generation and clean energy solutions.]
[Wind-powered energy-generated windmills on a green hillside.]
[Technician in hard hat and safety vest working on industrial equipment, representing Toshiba's
on-site services for manufacturing and critical infrastructure.]

## Driving Sustainability: Toshiba's Industrial and Infrastructure Innovations

Spearheading the manufacturing and infrastructure side of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics
Solutions, Toshiba International Corporation (TIC) delivers technologies for a resilient future. We
maximize efficiency with high-performance motors, hybrid vehicle systems, and power electronics like
UPS and solar inverters. From sustainable transportation to water treatment, TIC provides the
innovation and reliability that powers modern industry.

 

Discover how we’re revolutionizing industrial solutions and infrastructure for a better future.

[ Learn More ][248]

## Empowering the Future: Semiconductor & Data Innovations

Defining the technological edge of our Energy, Industrial, and Electronics Solutions, Toshiba
America Electronic Components (TAEC) leads in semiconductors and data storage. Our energy-efficient
power devices—including Si, SiC, and GaN—and high-capacity hard disk drives support a rapidly
developing AI world. From automotive to industrial applications, we deliver the technology driving
modern innovation.

 

Discover how we’re leading the semiconductor revolution for a smarter, more sustainable future.

[ Learn More ][249]
[Close-up of a Toshiba semiconductor chip overlaid on the internal components of a hard drive,
illustrating Toshiba’s advanced semiconductors and data storage solutions.]

## A world without fear of cancer

Siemens Healthineers is focused on elevating cancer care across the entire patient journey. By
enhancing the patient experience, enabling more personalized care, streamlining clinical workflows,
and making innovation accessible, we help care teams to improve outcomes for **a world without fear
of cancer**.

## Elevating cancer care across the entire patient journey

See how a connected cancer care approach turns growing complexity into coordinated action and
confident care — for patients, families, and care teams.

[ Explore the approach ][154]

## Theranostics is redefining what personalized care can look like

We support theranostics as a service line by integrating hardware, software, and services – so teams
can build with confidence.

AMI is accredited by the American College of Radiology (ACR), so that you can rest assured in our
ability to provide the quality diagnostic testing you need while adhering to the highest standards
to ensure your overall well-being is protected.

The care you need — when and where you need it

# Our Locations

AMI serves patients with a full range of imaging services at two convenient, welcoming locations —
our Main Campus, located in Bozeman Deaconess, and Cottonwood, at the corner of Huffine and
Cottonwood. If you have a doctor’s referral for a scan, we can help you schedule your appointment at
the right location for your needs.

## The AMI Difference

We provide patient-empowered care to support people as individuals — before, during, and after your
appointment. When you need one-on-one care that supports your wellbeing, dignity, and peace of mind
— Advanced Medical Imaging is here for you.

[About Us][75]
[Patient being greeted in waiting room shaking hands with nurse]

# Patient Testimonials

"I recently had an MRI, followed a week later by an MRI-guided biopsy. I was terrified for the
procedure as well as the possible outcome. All of the staff I encountered were amazing, from
check-in to completion, I felt important and cared for… through everything from explanations to IV
placement, to calming me."

"AMI is such a comfortable setting, clean and welcoming! Thank you for your efficiency and time
consideration. I appreciate the extra touches that make this annual visit better than it might have
been."

"Even though I live in Butte, I prefer to come to AMI for my mammogram, it's always quick and easy.
This clinic is very respectful of women. Thank you!"

# Patient Resources

We believe patient-centered healthcare includes easier access to the knowledge you need to make
decisions with confidence and peace of mind. Visit our Patient Resources page for important
information about financial assistance and more.[**
**][76]

[patient resources page][77]

## Our Team is Growing

AMI prioritizes caring for our patients’ wellbeing with compassion and professionalism. If you are
passionate about doing good work and making a difference for those in need, check out our Careers
page to learn about our open positions.

AMI is accredited by the American College of Radiology (ACR), so that you can rest assured in our
ability to provide the quality diagnostic testing you need while adhering to the highest standards
to ensure your overall well-being is protected.

The care you need — when and where you need it

# Our Locations

AMI serves patients with a full range of imaging services at two convenient, welcoming locations —
our Main Campus, located in Bozeman Deaconess, and Cottonwood, at the corner of Huffine and
Cottonwood. If you have a doctor’s referral for a scan, we can help you schedule your appointment at
the right location for your needs.

## The AMI Difference

We provide patient-empowered care to support people as individuals — before, during, and after your
appointment. When you need one-on-one care that supports your wellbeing, dignity, and peace of mind
— Advanced Medical Imaging is here for you.

[About Us][75]
[Patient being greeted in waiting room shaking hands with nurse]

# Patient Testimonials

"I recently had an MRI, followed a week later by an MRI-guided biopsy. I was terrified for the
procedure as well as the possible outcome. All of the staff I encountered were amazing, from
check-in to completion, I felt important and cared for… through everything from explanations to IV
placement, to calming me."

"AMI is such a comfortable setting, clean and welcoming! Thank you for your efficiency and time
consideration. I appreciate the extra touches that make this annual visit better than it might have
been."

"Even though I live in Butte, I prefer to come to AMI for my mammogram, it's always quick and easy.
This clinic is very respectful of women. Thank you!"

# Patient Resources

We believe patient-centered healthcare includes easier access to the knowledge you need to make
decisions with confidence and peace of mind. Visit our Patient Resources page for important
information about financial assistance and more.[**
**][76]

[patient resources page][77]

## Our Team is Growing

AMI prioritizes caring for our patients’ wellbeing with compassion and professionalism. If you are
passionate about doing good work and making a difference for those in need, check out our Careers
page to learn about our open positions.

## What Our Patients Have to Say

“The staff are not only incredibly kind and gentle but they are experts at what they do. Everyone
made me feel extremely comfortable. Hats off to the staff here, truly a wonderful experience for

## What Our Patients Have to Say

“The staff are not only incredibly kind and gentle but they are experts at what they do. Everyone
made me feel extremely comfortable. Hats off to the staff here, truly a wonderful experience for
some of the worst pain I’ve ever felt”

“The staff was incredibly friendly and the tech was extremely attentive, warm, knowledgeable and
paid very close attention to my concerns while answering all of my questions. The Doctor had a
wonderful bedside manner and took the time to review my imaging while carefully explaining the
entire procedure. Results are incredible! I feel very lucky to have the Beam Team support me on my
journey to best manage my pain. Thank you, my experience was exceptional.”

“State of the art facility. Calgary is blessed to have a world class pain management clinic.
Compassionate, polite and friendly staff”

experience.”

get my injections at this clinic, I’m very thankful I found them. My quality of life has improved
greatly with the pain management team.”

course the doctor. This was truly a nice breath of fresh air to have such a positive medical
experience. Thank you!”

“The staff were incredibly nice, kind, and professional throughout my visit. They made me feel
comfortable and cared for from start to finish. The environment is clean and welcoming, and the team
goes above and beyond to ensure patients feel supported. I truly appreciate their kindness and
highly recommend their services to anyone in need of radiology care.”

“I am fairly new to Alberta, so finding a facility and staff of doctors and technicians like Beam
has been a God Send to me. The overall concept is brilliant and the level of timeliness,
friendliness, care and quality of service has been truly exceptional. There is no doubt that I will
continue to use Beam in the future, and I highly recommend them.”

# NHS website for England Find information and services to help you manage your health

## [Health A to Z][8]

Find out about conditions, symptoms, medicines, tests and treatments, including when to get help

## [NHS services][9]

Find out about NHS services including GPs, pharmacies, prescriptions, hospitals and dentists

* [ Find a GP ][17]
* [ Find NHS talking therapies for anxiety and depression ][18]

[ Find other NHS services ][19]

### Help from NHS 111

If you're worried about a symptom and not sure what help you need, NHS 111 can tell you what to do
next.

Go to [111.nhs.uk][20] or [call 111][21].

For a life-threatening emergency call 999.

## Featured
* ### [ Book a COVID-19 vaccination appointment ][22]
  
  If you're eligible for the spring COVID-19 vaccine, you can book a vaccination appointment now
* ### [ Get healthcare cover abroad with a UK GHIC or EHIC ][23]
  
  Get or renew your health insurance card to help you get healthcare in the EU and some other
  countries
* ### [ Refer yourself for help for back and joint problems ][24]
  
  Get NHS help from community musculoskeletal (MSK) services, like physiotherapy, for back and joint
  problems

## More information and advice
* ## [Vaccinations][25]
  
  Information about vaccinations for babies, children and adults, including why they're important
  and how to get them
* ## [COVID-19][26]
  
  Advice about COVID-19, including symptoms, treatments and how to avoid catching and spreading it.
* ## [Baby][27]

* ## [Women's health][28]
  
  Information and support on health, wellbeing, conditions and screening
* ## [Contraception][29]

### Help from NHS 111

If you're worried about a symptom and not sure what help you need, NHS 111 can tell you what to do
next.

Go to [111.nhs.uk][20] or [call 111][21].

For a life-threatening emergency call 999.

  countries

  problems

Genesis Breast Screening is designed for women who want clarity, comfort, and control over their

[ See If Genesis Is Right for You ][22]
* You’ve been told you have dense breast tissue and want additional clarity
* You believe early detection and preventative screening matter
* You prefer clear, transparent pricing without insurance confusion
* You want a calm, supportive screening experience
EXPERIENCE & ENVIRONMENT

## Advanced Screening. Thoughtfully Delivered

From the moment you walk in, Genesis feels different. Our space is thoughtfully designed to reduce
anxiety and create a sense of ease—because how you feel matters just as much as the care you
receive.

We take the time to explain your screening, answer your questions, and ensure you feel supported
every step of the way.
TRANSPARENT PRICING

## Clear pricing. No surprises

Genesis Breast Screening is a cash-pay clinic, which means no hidden fees, no confusing insurance
processes, and no unexpected bills. You’ll know the cost of your screening upfront—so you can focus
on your health, not paperwork.

[ VIEW PRICING ][23]

## Take the next step with confidence

Scheduling your breast screening is simple, secure, and designed with your comfort in mind. Choose a
time that works for you and complete your booking online in just a few clicks.

[ Schedule Your Screening ][24]
[Woman speaking with staff at Genesis breast screening clinic reception in Tampa designed for a
comfortable experience.]
FAQ PREVIEW

## Questions? We’re here to help

−

### What is an automated breast ultrasound and is it safe?

Automated Breast ultrasound (ABUS) uses sound waves to create images of breast tissue. It does not
use radiation and is non-invasive. At Genesis, we use advanced automated breast ultrasound (ABUS)
technology to capture detailed images of the entire breast.

+

### Do I need a referral?

No referral is required to schedule a breast ultrasound (ABUS) screening at Genesis. However, we
encourage you to discuss your screening plan with your healthcare provider if you have questions or
specific medical concerns.

+

### Is this covered by insurance?

Genesis is a cash-pay clinic and does not bill insurance directly. Some patients choose to submit
receipts to their insurance provider or use HSA/FSA funds, depending on their plan.

+

### What should I expect during my appointment?

Your visit is designed to be simple, comfortable, and efficient.

When you arrive, you’ll be welcomed into a calm, private setting. A trained technologist will guide
you through the process and perform your automated breast ultrasound (ABUS) screening while you lie
comfortably.

The exam typically takes 20–30 minutes and does not involve compression or radiation.

[ View All FAQs ][25]

## Your health deserves clarity and compassion.

At Genesis Breast Screening, we’re committed to helping women take proactive steps toward their
health—without fear, confusion, or pressure. We’re honored to be part of your care journey.

[ Schedule Your Screening ][26]

Receive helpful information about dense breast tissue, screening options, and early detection — so
you can make confident decisions about your breast health.

We only send occasional screening information.
No spam. Unsubscribe anytime

[Read more][79] 16 October 2025 ##### IntechOpen Among First Publishers to Go Live with OA Switchboard Books Solution We are proud to announce that IntechOpen is among the first three publishers, alongside Cambridge University Press and University of Michigan Press, to go live with the OA Switchboard Books Solution. Marshall, this book offers insightful research and novel approaches, contributing to the continuous discourse on *Helicobacter pylori*-related research. [Read more][84] 11 March 2024 ##### IntechOpen Signs Open Access Institutional Agreement with Iowa State University IntechOpen signs an institutional agreement with Iowa State University of Science and Technology to support open access and cover open access publishing fees for their faculty. [Read more][85] 07 June 2023 ##### IntechOpen Becomes a UKSG Member IntechOpen is now an official member of the UKSG, the UK's largest scholarly communications community. Founded almost half a century ago, it connects the knowledge community and encourages the exchange of ideas in scholarly communication. [Read more][86] 28 March 2023 ##### IntechOpen Book Wins the 2022 International Academy of Astronautics Life Science Book Award We are thrilled that the International Academy of Astronautics has chosen IntechOpen's book "Preparation of Space Experiments", edited by Dr. Vladimir Pletser, to receive the IAA Life Science Book Award. The award is given annually to recognize excellence in publication by an Academy member or corresponding member in the field of life sciences. LOGIQ Ultrasound

## Engineered to elevate diagnostic clarity and empower confident clinical decisions

The latest LOGIQ ultrasound solutions empowers ultrasound departments to meet today's challenges
with confidence.

With **advanced imaging, AI-powered workflows**, and **a flexible digital platform**, it delivers
efficient care across diverse clinical needs.
[ [Chello] ][48]
LOGIQ Series Digital Platform

## Concise workflow & a platform for future

GE HealthCare delivers a concise workflow and a platform built for the future, powered by advanced
AI tools that help detect and segment anatomies to boost measurement accuracy, streamline system
interactions, and enhance overall clinical efficiency. The LOGIQ family continues to accelerate
innovation, offering robust enterprise-ready features that support standardization, security, and
long-term value across your ultrasound fleet—making it a smart investment for today and the years
ahead. Expanded LOGIQ AppAPI capabilities enable users to pioneer their own cutting-edge innovations
for research purposes and to access a growing number of third-party applications.
[ [Logiq ai video preview] ][49]
Perfect versatility

## One system for all care areas

From head to toe, for every body – LOGIQ ultrasound machines support you with dedicated solutions.

'One-stop shop' solution for liver disease management, to see and quantify in a single exam

From superficial to deep anatomies, from small joints to soft tissues, from trauma to inflammatory
disease

Improving confidence and efficiency across the head and neck care pathway.

[quotation mark]

## Confident diagnosis through exceptional imaging

LOGIQ Ultrasound provides a high standard in imaging, so clinicians can scan, diagnose, and treat a
wide range of patients and body types across a broad spectrum of conditions.
High clinical confidence Comprehensive clinical coverage Vascular techniques High definition
displays
[ [High clinical confidence] ][68]

#### Images of exceptional uniformity, from near to far field

The latest Imaging solutions available on the LOGIQ Ultrasound, automatically delivers images of
exceptional uniformity, from near to far field, adapting to different acoustic models. With the
advanced cSound™ Architecture, heart of the LOGIQ E10 Series, the system delivers much higher
processing power than our previous systems. No need to adjust manually the focus – the information
you need is there, instantly. This is combined with all pixels automatically in focus, enhanced
spatial and contrast resolution and boosted vascular performances.
[Learn more about the advantages of the cSound™ imaging technology ][69] [Learn more about the LOGIQ
agile ultrasound technology ][70]
[Comprehensive clinical coverage]

#### Powerful high fidelity and broad bandwidth transducers

LOGIQ Ultrasound features a wide portfolio of probes (E-Series and XDclear™) to cover multi-purpose
needs. Powerful high fidelity and broad bandwidth transducers produce high resolution images whether
scanning superficial or deep targets, or at any point in between. Depending on the machines.
[Learn more about the advantages of the XDclear™ Probe Technology ][71]
[Vascular techniques]

#### Multiple flow modes that can be used in different contexts

LOGIQ Ultrasound features multiple flow modes that can be used in different contexts.

The proprietary B-Flow Imaging provides enhanced sensitivity to small vessels and slow flow states,
and enables side-by-side display of B-Mode and B-Flow images. An innovative new tool, Radiantflow™,
provides a near-3D look when visualizing blood flow in tiny vessels, especially when combined with
Micro Vascular Imaging (MVI).
[Learn more about the LOGIQ Vascular solutions ][72] [Watch the B-Flow Video ][73]
[High definition displays]

#### High contrast and deep blacks, vibrant colors, excellent image quality

LOGIQ Ultrasound features High-Definition widescreen monitors across the portfolio. No matter which
technology, depending on the selected product, the featured monitor provides high contrast and deep
blacks, extraordinarily vibrant colors, and excellent image quality. To see what you need with
clarity.

#### Images of exceptional uniformity, from near to far field

The latest Imaging solutions available on the LOGIQ Ultrasound, automatically delivers images of
exceptional uniformity, from near to far field, adapting to different acoustic models. With the
advanced cSound™ Architecture, heart of the LOGIQ E10 Series, the system delivers much higher
processing power than our previous systems. No need to adjust manually the focus – the information
you need is there, instantly. This is combined with all pixels automatically in focus, enhanced
spatial and contrast resolution and boosted vascular performances.

#### Powerful high fidelity and broad bandwidth transducers

LOGIQ Ultrasound features a wide portfolio of probes (E-Series and XDclear™) to cover multi-purpose
needs. Powerful high fidelity and broad bandwidth transducers produce high resolution images whether
scanning superficial or deep targets, or at any point in between. Depending on the machines.

Micro Vascular Imaging (MVI).

[ [post market surveillance] ][23]

#### [ From Compliance to Clinical Action: Fixing the Broken Loop in Post-Market Surveillance ][24]

By Aalap Patel, MS, CQE, CSSBB

Post-market surveillance (PMS) systems in the medical device industry have become increasingly
sophisticated in collecting complaints, monitoring adverse events, and generating regulatory
reports. However, many organizations still struggle to translate these insights into timely clinical
action and meaningful patient safety improvements. This article examines the growing disconnect
between regulatory reporting and operational decision-making, explores the challenges of signal
detection and prioritization, and outlines practical strategies for building closed-loop PMS systems
that improve patient safety outcomes and organizational responsiveness.

Operational AI Capability Maturity Model — a five-domain framework built specifically for regulatory
affairs and offers a direct way to assess where your organization actually stands. If your team
cannot consistently answer who approved the tool, how the output was verified, and what was

#### [ Value, Focus, and the Future of MedTech: M&A and Divestitures are Rewriting the
#### Strategic Playbook. ][33]

By Joan Hinrichs

leaders to reshape portfolios for strategic advantage, long-term growth, and greater value to
patients - unlocking their full potential.

#### [ The Boston Children’s Experience: Hidden ICU Risk and AI-Driven De-escalation ][34]

By Evan Butler

Boston Children’s Hospital physicians say one of the greatest risks in pediatric ICUs is delayed
de-escalation of care, which can expose children to prolonged ventilation, sedation, and vasoactive
medications. They argue that AI-driven clinical intelligence can help clinicians identify safer
timing for weaning and extubation, supporting recovery and improving long-term outcomes.

#### [ Medtronic Bets on Cardiovascular Realignment Amid Stock Pressure and Facility Closures ][35]

By MedTech Intelligence Staff

Medtronic is overhauling its cardiovascular business in a major restructuring that includes new
operating divisions, ongoing acquisitions, and a strategic push into higher-growth cardiac
technologies. At the same time, the company plans to close its longtime Santa Rosa facility,
affecting hundreds of employees and marking a significant shift in its U.S. manufacturing footprint.
The changes come as Medtronic navigates investor pressure, intensifying competition, and a rapidly
evolving cardiovascular device market.

## Advanced Breast & Comprehensive Ultrasound Imaging

At PrimaVue Diagnostic Imaging, we combine advanced ultrasound technology with a personalized and
compassionate patient experience. a PrimaVue is Proud to bring the first FDA-approved ABUS system to
Beverly Hills for advanced breast screening.

[Free consultation][11]
[Find your procedure][12]

## Luxury Diagnostic Imaging Focused on Early Detection and Ultimate Convenience

Through our established division, EZ Diagnostic Imaging Services, we also offer a comprehensive
suite of mobile ultrasound services—bringing state-of-the-art diagnostic imaging directly to your
home, clinic, hospital, or care facility across California. Whether you visit our luxurious office
or utilize our mobile services, our mission is to help you feel informed, empowered, and proactive
about your health.

[Request Mobile Ultrasound Services][13]

#### What Is Automated Breast Ultrasound (ABUS)?

#### What Every Woman Should Know About Dense Breasts

## More Than Imaging — A Comprehensive Approach to Your Health

PrimaVue Diagnostic Imaging and EZ Diagnostic Imaging Services were created to provide patients with
a more advanced, supportive, and empowering imaging experience.

We understand that approximately 40% of women (and up to 70% of Asian women) have dense breast
tissue, which can make it more difficult for abnormalities to be seen on a traditional mammogram. 

For these patients, our Beverly Hills clinic offers Invenia™ ABUS Premium technology, which has been
clinically shown to increase cancer detection by 35.7% in women with dense breasts when used
alongside mammography.

Beyond breast health, we recognize the critical need for accessible, high-quality general
diagnostics. Our mobile division eliminates the hassle of travel and waiting rooms by bringing
certified technicians and cutting-edge ultrasound equipment directly to you.

## Dense Breast Tissue Matters

Dense breasts are completely normal and very common. However, dense tissue and potential
abnormalities both appear white on a mammogram, so a suspicious lump may be hidden in dense tissue.
Furthermore, having dense breast tissue may increase the risk of developing breast cancer 4 to 6
times.PrimaVue Diagnostic Imaging offers advanced supplemental screening using Invenia™ ABUS
Premium, an FDA-approved automated breast ultrasound technology specifically designed for women with
dense breast tissue. When dense tissue is scanned with ultrasound, tissue appears white and masses
appear black—making them significantly easier to see. Our goal is to help patients feel informed,
proactive, and empowered when it comes to their breast health.

###### Comprehensive Diagnostic Ultrasound Services

In addition to advanced ABUS breast imaging, our team of ARDMS-registered sonographers performs a
full spectrum of diagnostic ultrasound services. These services are available at our Beverly Hills

2024 – стажировка по реконструкции молочной железы, по микрохирургии и лечении лимфедемы

### Saving Lives

### Dr. Daniel Herron

When adding SonoCiné to our practice, my hope was that in the first 1000 dense-breast women screened
with normal mammograms that we would find 3 cancers missed on mammography. We actually found our
first cancer after only 70 cases and our second cancer after the 100th case.

### Dr. Kevin M. Kelly

Almost 20 years ago, I realized that early detection of invasive breast cancer in women with dense
breast tissue would prevent the ravages of both the disease and the effects of its treatment. Since
then I have made it my single goal to provide an affordable, ultrasound method to accomplish this
task.

### Karen C.

It has been a year since my breast cancer diagnosis, and I wanted to thank you for finding it with
the automated whole breast ultrasound.

### Judy Dean, MD

I was an early adopter of automated whole-breast ultrasound. I have been using the SonoCiné system
since 2005 and in our first 7000 studies in about 3000 women, I am proud to say that we detected
over 30 occult breast cancers with SonoCiné that could not be seen on the mammograms.

### Cathy Babcook, MD

We’ve done 600 SonoCiné exams and found four additional Invasive Ductal cancers that we could not
see mammographically. So we know that we are finding breast cancers that otherwise we would not have
been able to find if we were not using this technology in addition to screening mammography.

### How it Works

SonoCiné AWBUS can be used with any high-quality ultrasound machines, to provide a consistent,
repeatable scans of the entirety of both breasts, including the axilla (underarm/lymph nodes).
Clinical studies show that adding SonoCiné to a yearly mammogram can improve cancer detection
results.

### Why SonoCiné?

][20]

### Saving Lives

### Dr. Daniel Herron

When adding SonoCiné to our practice, my hope was that in the first 1000 dense-breast women screened
with normal mammograms that we would find 3 cancers missed on mammography. We actually found our
first cancer after only 70 cases and our second cancer after the 100th case.

### Dr. Kevin M. Kelly

Almost 20 years ago, I realized that early detection of invasive breast cancer in women with dense
breast tissue would prevent the ravages of both the disease and the effects of its treatment. Since
then I have made it my single goal to provide an affordable, ultrasound method to accomplish this
task.

### Karen C.

It has been a year since my breast cancer diagnosis, and I wanted to thank you for finding it with
the automated whole breast ultrasound.

### Judy Dean, MD

I was an early adopter of automated whole-breast ultrasound. I have been using the SonoCiné system
since 2005 and in our first 7000 studies in about 3000 women, I am proud to say that we detected
over 30 occult breast cancers with SonoCiné that could not be seen on the mammograms.

### Cathy Babcook, MD

We’ve done 600 SonoCiné exams and found four additional Invasive Ductal cancers that we could not
see mammographically. So we know that we are finding breast cancers that otherwise we would not have
been able to find if we were not using this technology in addition to screening mammography.

results.

# Home New

## CANCER IS
## BEATABLE

## Early detection is the key
## to beating cancer!

[ Learn How ][71]
Why act now?

## 1 in 2 men,
## 1 in 2 women,
## 1 in 330 children...

## will have cancer in their lifetime.

According to American cancer society statistics, 96% of most cancers are curable if detected early
and treated before spreading.^{(1)}

# Act Now!

## Implement the 5-step plan to

#SpotandSurvive

## CANCER

### [Step 1:
### Signs & Symptoms][72]

To monitor yourself for early cancer detection, you must know the cancer signs and symptoms. A
listing of the various signs and symptoms are just a click away.

### [Step 2:
### Body Monitoring][73]

Cancer grows 24/7. Therefore, you must monitor your body to detect any abnormality between regular
doctor visits or screenings. The tools and methods are described in this section.

### [Step 3:
### Family History][74]

Knowing and charting your family medical history will help your medical team as they develop a
long-term wellness program suited to your unique needs.

### [Step 4:
### Medical Team][75]

Cancer is not self-healing. Therefore, when spotting a cancer sign or symptom, consider it a red
flag that should cause you to consult your medical team immediately to determine if it is cancer or
another illness.

### [Step 5:
### Screening & Testing][76]

Not all cancer signs and symptoms are visible. You should establish specific times for the various
cancer screening and tests with your medical team.

Make It a Habit!
Happy

## What does wearing a seatbelt
## have to do with cancer?

A regular body monitoring habit is same as a seatbelt habit…  Check out video as to why.

## 1 in 2 men,
## 1 in 2 women,

#SpotandSurvive

### Signs & Symptoms][72]

To monitor yourself for early cancer detection, you must know the cancer signs and symptoms. A
listing of the various signs and symptoms are just a click away.

### [Step 2:
### Body Monitoring][73]

Cancer grows 24/7. Therefore, you must monitor your body to detect any abnormality between regular
doctor visits or screenings. The tools and methods are described in this section.

### [Step 3:
### Family History][74]

Knowing and charting your family medical history will help your medical team as they develop a
long-term wellness program suited to your unique needs.

### Medical Team][75]

flag that should cause you to consult your medical team immediately to determine if it is cancer or
another illness.

### [Step 5:
### Screening & Testing][76]

Not all cancer signs and symptoms are visible. You should establish specific times for the various
cancer screening and tests with your medical team.

# Welcome to the Toronto Centre for Medical Imaging

### Specializing in Diagnostic Imaging Services – 416-368-8488

The Toronto Centre for Medical Imaging (TCFMI), located in the heart of downtown Toronto – in the
financial district – is a state of the art medical imaging clinic providing the following diagnostic
imaging services: X-Rays, Ultrasounds, Mammography, and Bone Density Tests.

Specialized procedures also include Ultrasound for Sports Injuries, Vascular Ultrasound and Full
Range of Obstetric Ultrasound.

#### New – [Immigration Chest X Rays][19]

The Toronto Centre for Medical Imaging is a licensed diagnostic imaging clinic for performing
immigration Chest X Rays. A Chest X Ray is performed on all clients immigrating to Canada as part of
their Immigration Medical Examination as directed by Citizenship and Immigration Canada. The patient
must bring in a signed referral form from a panel physician to our office with the E Medical
documents and Interim Federal Health (IFH) certificate.

[Learn More][20]

#### New – [Automated Breast Ultrasound (ABUS)][21]

The Toronto Centre for Medical Imaging is the first dedicated medical imaging clinic in Ontario to
offer the [**Automated Breast Ultrasound**][22]. An Automated Breast Ultrasound uses high frequency
sound waves to take 3D images of the whole breast, ensuring they are displayed in a reproducible
fashion.

It is especially beneficial for women with dense breast tissue, because dense breast tissue can make
a mammogram harder to read. Automated Breast Ultrasound is now recommended as supplemental screening
in conjunction with screening mammography for women with dense breasts (BI-RADS Type C and D).

[Learn More][23]
[Myths and Facts on ABUS – Learn More][24]

#### We Value Short Wait Times For Mammograms & Other Imaging Tests

Due to the pandemic, wait times for most medical procedures throughout the province may have
increased – including for tests such as screening mammograms.

At the Toronto Centre for Medical Imaging, our wait times are short for screening [mammogram][25] to
accommodate our patients in a timely fashion.  Urgent mammograms can be booked within 24-48 hours.

We are proud to announce the voluntary re-accreditation for Ultrasound by the American College of
Radiology for 20 continuous years. TCFMI is the only medical imaging clinic in Canada with this
accreditation.

[Toronto Centre For Medical Imaging]


### State-of-the-Art Medical Imaging Facility in Downtown Toronto

When you call our office, you will speak to a receptionist who will make sure that your appointment
is scheduled in a timely manner. We take pride in keeping our waiting times short. When you arrive,
you can expect to be greeted by a friendly receptionist in a pleasant, bright, modern medical
imaging facility.

Change into a customized gown that does not embarrass, relax in a comfortable, private waiting area.
But don’t get too comfortable, as you will be taken for your appointment on time!

In our spacious examining rooms, you can expect to have your examination performed by highly
trained, professionals using state of the art digital equipment. Our protocols have passed the
rigorous standards of various National Accreditation bodies.

We make what frequently is an unpleasant necessity of life … pleasant!

# Welcome to the Toronto Centre for Medical Imaging

### Specializing in Diagnostic Imaging Services – 416-368-8488

The Toronto Centre for Medical Imaging (TCFMI), located in the heart of downtown Toronto – in the
financial district – is a state of the art medical imaging clinic providing the following diagnostic
imaging services: X-Rays, Ultrasounds, Mammography, and Bone Density Tests.

Specialized procedures also include Ultrasound for Sports Injuries, Vascular Ultrasound and Full
Range of Obstetric Ultrasound.

#### New – [Immigration Chest X Rays][19]

The Toronto Centre for Medical Imaging is a licensed diagnostic imaging clinic for performing
immigration Chest X Rays. A Chest X Ray is performed on all clients immigrating to Canada as part of
their Immigration Medical Examination as directed by Citizenship and Immigration Canada. The patient
must bring in a signed referral form from a panel physician to our office with the E Medical
documents and Interim Federal Health (IFH) certificate.

[Learn More][20]

#### New – [Automated Breast Ultrasound (ABUS)][21]

The Toronto Centre for Medical Imaging is the first dedicated medical imaging clinic in Ontario to
offer the [**Automated Breast Ultrasound**][22]. An Automated Breast Ultrasound uses high frequency
sound waves to take 3D images of the whole breast, ensuring they are displayed in a reproducible
fashion.

It is especially beneficial for women with dense breast tissue, because dense breast tissue can make
a mammogram harder to read. Automated Breast Ultrasound is now recommended as supplemental screening
in conjunction with screening mammography for women with dense breasts (BI-RADS Type C and D).

[Learn More][23]
[Myths and Facts on ABUS – Learn More][24]

#### We Value Short Wait Times For Mammograms & Other Imaging Tests

Due to the pandemic, wait times for most medical procedures throughout the province may have
increased – including for tests such as screening mammograms.

At the Toronto Centre for Medical Imaging, our wait times are short for screening [mammogram][25] to
accommodate our patients in a timely fashion.  Urgent mammograms can be booked within 24-48 hours.

We are proud to announce the voluntary re-accreditation for Ultrasound by the American College of
Radiology for 20 continuous years. TCFMI is the only medical imaging clinic in Canada with this
accreditation.

[Toronto Centre For Medical Imaging]


### State-of-the-Art Medical Imaging Facility in Downtown Toronto

When you call our office, you will speak to a receptionist who will make sure that your appointment
is scheduled in a timely manner. We take pride in keeping our waiting times short. When you arrive,
you can expect to be greeted by a friendly receptionist in a pleasant, bright, modern medical
imaging facility.

Change into a customized gown that does not embarrass, relax in a comfortable, private waiting area.
But don’t get too comfortable, as you will be taken for your appointment on time!

In our spacious examining rooms, you can expect to have your examination performed by highly
trained, professionals using state of the art digital equipment. Our protocols have passed the
rigorous standards of various National Accreditation bodies.

We make what frequently is an unpleasant necessity of life … pleasant!
